question: Which AI-powered robot developed by ISRO will be deployed in the uncrewed test flight for India's Gaganyaan mission in December 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vyommitra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Vyommitra, an AI-powered half-humanoid robot, will be deployed in an uncrewed test flight of India's Gaganyaan space mission in December 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vyommitra is an AI-powered robot developed by ISRO, designed to simulate human functions during flight.**
 
• **It will play a key role in testing life support systems and assessing onboard conditions in preparation for India’s first manned space mission.**
 
• **Vyommitra is part of the Gaganyaan Mission, India’s first human spaceflight program.**
 
• **The robot will be aboard the uncrewed test flight scheduled for December 2025, aimed at simulating human presence in space.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Gaganyaan Mission**__

 __
 
• India's first human spaceflight program.
 
• Objective: Send astronauts to a 400 km low Earth orbit (LEO) for 3 days.
 
• Uncrewed test flight scheduled for December 2025.
 
• Aimed at testing life support systems, safety protocols, and re-entry mechanisms.
 
 
 
• **Vyommitra**__
 
 
• AI-powered, half-humanoid robot.
 
• Developed by ISRO to simulate astronaut functions in space.
 
• Monitors environmental parameters like pressure, temperature, and CO₂ inside the spacecraft.
